work_completed: AGENT-LOOP-002 T6 (interaction execution), asked for by Joshua 2026-10-18. `use` only occupies (the brief's default; Joshua's question is open).

AvatarCharacter.ApplyInteraction(verb, anchor): reserve -> walk to the approach point -> on arrival face the object (FacePoint) and hold via the new InteractionController (sit 8 s, rest 12 s, use 5 s of simulation time) -> release -> wander fallback. Activity (active/sitting/resting/using/looking) is shown on the avatar's label and exposed read-only with HeldAnchor.
Any new intent ends an interaction and frees its object; 'wait' carries on with one under way; a repeat of the same interaction carries on; a scene transition (OnPlaced) ends it.
look_at turns the avatar to face the target and holds 2 s without moving; for an anchor with a FacePoint, ingress resolves look_at to the object's centre rather than the approach point.
AgentBrain.DropHeldDecision: when a hold starts, the last movement stops at once (decelerating through the locomotion ramp; nothing is placed).
IntentIngress: sit/use/rest on a non-doorway anchor go to ApplyInteraction (a reservation race is rejected 'occupied'); AnchorAffordances.Recheck covers a targeted rest.

decisions_made: No seated or lying animations exist (character animation is blocked on GRAPH-001 G1), and snapping the body onto a seat would add a second placement discontinuity. So the body stays at the approach point it walked to; the pose shows as facing the object, holding still, and the label's word. Real poses can replace the label when animations land.
'wait' does not interrupt an interaction under way; any other intent does. Without this, Fusion's 2 s decision cadence would stand a sitting avatar up almost at once.
Hold durations are constants on AvatarCharacter (SitSeconds, RestSeconds, UseSeconds, LookSeconds).
